028/**
029 * Doesn't care about command points etc, just functions in a different way. May use command points/tasks/etc
030 * to accomplish its goals, just as an implementation detail, but conceptually it's fundamentally different from how
031 * human-type fleets work.
032 * 
033 * @author Alex
034 *
035 */
036public class ThreatCombatStrategyAI {
037        
038        public static int MAX_FABRICATORS = 2;
039        
040        public static float SND_BASE = 60f;
041        public static float SND_TIMER = 60f;
042        public static float SND_FRACTION = 0.5f;
043        
044        protected boolean playerSide;
045        protected CombatTaskManagerAPI taskManager;
046        protected CombatFleetManagerAPI fleetManager;
047        protected CombatFleetManagerAPI enemyFleetManager;
048        protected int owner;
049        protected boolean allyMode = false;
050        
051        protected IntervalUtil everySecond = new IntervalUtil(0.8f, 1.2f);
052        protected CombatEngineAPI engine;
053        protected float mw, mh;
054        
055        protected boolean abort = false;
056        
057        protected AssignmentInfo mainDefend1;
058        protected AssignmentInfo mainDefend2;
059        
060        protected float captureAllTimeRemaining; 
061        protected boolean gaveInitialOrders = false;
062        protected boolean everHadFabricatorDeployed = false;
063        
064        protected float untilSNDOnSkirmishUnits; 
065        
066        
067        public ThreatCombatStrategyAI(int owner) {
068                engine = Global.getCombatEngine();
069                this.owner = owner;
070                playerSide = owner == 0;
071                allyMode = playerSide;
072                //allyMode = false;
073                fleetManager = engine.getFleetManager(owner);
074                taskManager = fleetManager.getTaskManager(allyMode);
075                taskManager.getCommandPointsStat().modifyFlat("ThreatCombatStrategyAI", 1000000000);
076                
077                enemyFleetManager = engine.getFleetManager(owner == 0 ? 1 : 0);
078                
079                if (fleetManager.getGoal() == FleetGoal.ESCAPE || enemyFleetManager.getGoal() == FleetGoal.ESCAPE) {
080                        abort = true;
081                }
082                
083                mw = engine.getMapWidth();
084                mh = engine.getMapHeight();
085                
086                resetSNDTimer();
087        }
088        
089        protected void resetSNDTimer() {
090                untilSNDOnSkirmishUnits = SND_TIMER * (0.75f + (float) Math.random() * 0.5f); 
091                untilSNDOnSkirmishUnits += SND_BASE; 
092        }
093        
094        protected void manageSND(float amount) {
095                untilSNDOnSkirmishUnits -= amount;
096                if (captureAllTimeRemaining > 0) return;
097                if (untilSNDOnSkirmishUnits <= 0) {
098                        for (DeployedFleetMemberAPI member : fleetManager.getDeployedCopyDFM()) {
099                                ShipAPI ship = member.getShip();
100                                if (ship == null || ship.getAI() == null) continue;
101                                if (ship.hasTag(ThreatShipConstructionScript.SHIP_UNDER_CONSTRUCTION)) continue;
102                                
103                                if (!ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.THREAT_SKIRMISH)) continue;
104                                if ((float) Math.random() > SND_FRACTION) continue;
105                                
106                                cancelOrders(member, false);
107                                ship.getAIFlags().setFlag(AIFlags.IGNORES_ORDERS, SND_BASE * (0.75f + (float) Math.random() * 0.5f));
108                        }
109                        resetSNDTimer();
110                }
111        }
112        
113        protected void giveInitialOrders() {
114                if (fleetManager.getAdmiralAI() != null) {
115                        taskManager.clearTasks();
116                        fleetManager.getAdmiralAI().setNoOrders(true);
117                }
118                
119                captureAllTimeRemaining = 80f;
120                for (BattleObjectiveAPI curr : engine.getObjectives()) {
121                        taskManager.createAssignment(CombatAssignmentType.CAPTURE, curr, false);
122                }               
123        }
124        
125        
126        public void advance(float amount) {
127                //if (true) return;
128                if (abort) return;
129                if (engine.isPaused()) return;
130                
131                captureAllTimeRemaining -= amount;
132                
133                manageSND(amount);
134                
135                everySecond.advance(amount);
136                if (everySecond.intervalElapsed()) {
137                        // if non-threat ships are deployed from this fleetManager, don't want to be doing any Threat things
138                        List<DeployedFleetMemberAPI> deployed = fleetManager.getDeployedCopyDFM();
139                        if (deployed.isEmpty()) return;
140                        
141                        boolean someMatching = false;
142                        for (DeployedFleetMemberAPI member : deployed) {
143                                if (!member.isFighterWing() && member.getShip() != null &&
144                                                member.isAlly() == allyMode &&
145                                                !member.getShip().getVariant().hasHullMod(HullMods.THREAT_HULLMOD)) {
146                                        abort = true;
147                                        return;
148                                } else if (!member.isFighterWing() && member.getShip() != null &&
149                                                member.isAlly() == allyMode) {
150                                        someMatching = true;
151                                }
152                        }
153                        
154                        if (!someMatching) return;
155                        
156                        if (!gaveInitialOrders) {
157                                giveInitialOrders();
158                                gaveInitialOrders = true;
159                        }
160                        
161                        float sign = 1f;
162                        if (owner == 0) sign = -1;
163                        Vector2f enemyCom = getEnemyCenterOfMass();
164                        //Vector2f fabricatorLoc = new Vector2f(0, 0 + mh * 0.33f * sign);
165                        Vector2f fabricatorLoc = new Vector2f(0, 0 + mh * 0.3f * sign);
166                        Vector2f axis = Misc.getUnitVector(fabricatorLoc, enemyCom);
167                        Vector2f perp = new Vector2f(axis.y, -axis.x);
168                        float distToEnemyCom = Misc.getDistance(fabricatorLoc, enemyCom);
169                        
170                        //float hiveOffset = 2000f;
171                        float hiveOffset = distToEnemyCom - 6000f;
172                        if (Math.abs(hiveOffset) < 2000f) {
173                                hiveOffset = Math.signum(hiveOffset) * 2000f;
174                        }
175                        if (hiveOffset > 2000) hiveOffset= 2000f;
176                        Vector2f hiveLoc = new Vector2f(axis);
177                        hiveLoc.scale(hiveOffset);
178                        Vector2f.add(hiveLoc, fabricatorLoc, hiveLoc);
179
180                        float enemyWeightNearFabricatorLoc = Misc.countEnemyWeightInArcAroundLocation(
181                                        owner, fabricatorLoc, 0f, 360f, 3000f, null, true, true);
182                        
183                        int fabricators = 0;
184                        int hives = 0;
185                        int combat = 0;
186                        for (DeployedFleetMemberAPI member : fleetManager.getDeployedCopyDFM()) {
187                                ShipAPI ship = member.getShip();
188                                if (ship == null || ship.getAI() == null) continue;
189                                if (isFabricator(ship)) {
190                                        fabricators++;
191                                }
192                                if (isHive(ship)) {
193                                        hives++;
194                                }
195                                if (isCombatUnit(ship)) {
196                                        combat++;
197                                }
198                        }
199                        
200                        if (fabricators > 0) {
201                                everHadFabricatorDeployed = true;
202                        }
203                        
204                        float defDist = distToEnemyCom - 2000f;
205                        if (enemyWeightNearFabricatorLoc >= 3f) {
206                                defDist = Math.min(defDist, 3000f);
207                        }
208                        if (fabricators == 0 && hives == 0) {
209                                if (mainDefend1 != null) {
210                                        taskManager.removeAssignment(mainDefend1);
211                                        mainDefend1 = null;
212                                }
213                                if (mainDefend2 != null) {
214                                        taskManager.removeAssignment(mainDefend2);
215                                        mainDefend2 = null;
216                                }
217                        } else if (defDist < 2000f) {
218                                if (mainDefend1 != null) {
219                                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(mainDefend1.getTarget().getLocation(), fabricatorLoc);
220                                        if (dist > 1000f) {
221                                                taskManager.removeAssignment(mainDefend1);
222                                                mainDefend1 = null;
223                                        }
224                                }
225
226                                if (mainDefend2 != null) {
227                                        taskManager.removeAssignment(mainDefend2);
228                                        mainDefend2 = null;
229                                }
230                                
231                                if (mainDefend1 == null) {
232                                        AssignmentTargetAPI wp = taskManager.createWaypoint2(fabricatorLoc, allyMode);
233                                        mainDefend1 = taskManager.createAssignment(CombatAssignmentType.DEFEND, wp, false);
234                                }
235                                
236                                //Global.getCombatEngine().getCombatUI().addMessage(0, "Threat aggro mode engaged!");
237                                // enemies close to fabricators - attack! 
238                                for (DeployedFleetMemberAPI member : fleetManager.getDeployedCopyDFM()) {
239                                        ShipAPI ship = member.getShip();
240                                        if (ship == null || ship.getAI() == null) continue;
241                                        if (isCombatUnit(ship) && ship.getAI() instanceof ShipAIPlugin) {
242//                                              ShipAIPlugin ai = (ShipAIPlugin) ship.getAI();
243//                                              ShipAIConfig config = ai.getConfig();
244//                                              config.personalityOverride = Personalities.RECKLESS;
245//                                              config.alwaysStrafeOffensively = true;
246//                                              config.backingOffWhileNotVentingAllowed = false;
247//                                              config.turnToFaceWithUndamagedArmor = false;
248//                                              config.burnDriveIgnoreEnemies = true;
249                                                ship.getAIFlags().setFlag(AIFlags.DO_NOT_BACK_OFF, 2f);
250                                                ship.getAIFlags().setFlag(AIFlags.DO_NOT_VENT, 2f);
251                                                ship.getAIFlags().setFlag(AIFlags.IGNORES_ORDERS, 2f);
252                                        }
253                                }
254                        } else {
255                                Vector2f defLoc = new Vector2f(axis);
256                                defLoc.scale(defDist);
257                                Vector2f.add(defLoc, fabricatorLoc, defLoc);
258                                
259                                Vector2f defLoc1 = new Vector2f(perp);
260                                defLoc1.scale(1000f);
261                                Vector2f.add(defLoc1, defLoc, defLoc1);
262                                
263                                Vector2f defLoc2 = new Vector2f(perp);
264                                defLoc2.scale(-1000f);
265                                Vector2f.add(defLoc2, defLoc, defLoc2);
266                                
267                                
268                                if (mainDefend1 != null) {
269                                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(mainDefend1.getTarget().getLocation(), defLoc1);
270                                        if (dist > 1000f) {
271                                                taskManager.removeAssignment(mainDefend1);
272                                                mainDefend1 = null;
273                                        }
274                                }
275                                if (mainDefend2 != null) {
276                                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(mainDefend2.getTarget().getLocation(), defLoc2);
277                                        if (dist > 1000f) {
278                                                taskManager.removeAssignment(mainDefend2);
279                                                mainDefend2 = null;
280                                        }
281                                }
282                                
283                                if (mainDefend1 == null) {
284                                        AssignmentTargetAPI wp = taskManager.createWaypoint2(defLoc1, allyMode);
285                                        mainDefend1 = taskManager.createAssignment(CombatAssignmentType.DEFEND, wp, false);
286                                }
287                                
288                                if (mainDefend2 == null) {
289                                        AssignmentTargetAPI wp = taskManager.createWaypoint2(defLoc2, allyMode);
290                                        mainDefend2 = taskManager.createAssignment(CombatAssignmentType.DEFEND, wp, false);
291                                }
292                        }
293                        
294                        if (captureAllTimeRemaining <= 0f) {
295                                float axisAngle = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(axis);
296                                List<AssignmentTargetAPI> withCaptures = new ArrayList<>();
297                                for (AssignmentInfo info : taskManager.getAllAssignments()) {
298                                        if (info.getTarget() == null) continue;
299                                        if (info.getType() == CombatAssignmentType.CAPTURE || info.getType() == CombatAssignmentType.CONTROL) {
300                                                if ((fabricators == 0 && hives == 0) ||
301                                                                !wantsToControl(fabricatorLoc, axisAngle, distToEnemyCom, info.getTarget().getLocation())) {
302                                                        taskManager.removeAssignment(info);
303                                                } else {
304                                                        withCaptures.add(info.getTarget());
305                                                }
306                                        }
307                                }
308                                
309                                if (fabricators > 0 || hives > 0) {
310                                        for (BattleObjectiveAPI curr : engine.getObjectives()) {
311                                                if (withCaptures.contains(curr)) continue;
312                                                if (wantsToControl(fabricatorLoc, axisAngle, distToEnemyCom, curr.getLocation())) {
313                                                        taskManager.createAssignment(CombatAssignmentType.CAPTURE, curr, false);
314                                                }
315                                        }
316                                }
317                        }
318                        
319                        Set<DeployedFleetMemberAPI> escorted = new LinkedHashSet<>();
320                        
321                        for (DeployedFleetMemberAPI member : fleetManager.getDeployedCopyDFM()) {
322                                ShipAPI ship = member.getShip();
323                                if (ship == null || ship.getAI() == null) continue;
324                                if (ship.hasTag(ThreatShipConstructionScript.SHIP_UNDER_CONSTRUCTION)) continue;
325                                
326                                float enemyCheckRange = 3000f;
327                                if (isHive(ship)) {
328                                        enemyCheckRange = 1000f;
329                                }
330                                
331                                float enemyWeight = Misc.countEnemyWeightInArcAroundLocation(owner, ship.getLocation(), 0f, 360f, enemyCheckRange, null, true, true);
332                                float shipWeight = Misc.getShipWeight(ship, true);
333                                
334                                boolean enemiesNear = enemyWeight >= shipWeight * 0.5f;
335                                
336                                if (isFabricator(ship)) {
337                                        float min = 0f;
338                                        float max = 1000f;
339                                        if (enemiesNear) {
340                                                min = 1000f;
341                                                max = 2000f;
342                                        }
343                                        giveMovementOrder(member, fabricatorLoc, min, max);
344                                } else if (isHive(ship)) {
345                                        if (enemiesNear) {
346                                                cancelOrders(member, true);
347                                        } else {
348                                                giveMovementOrder(member, hiveLoc, 1000f, 1500f);
349                                        }
350                                } else if (isOverseer(ship)) {
351                                        DeployedFleetMemberAPI closest = null;
352                                        float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
353                                        for (DeployedFleetMemberAPI other : fleetManager.getDeployedCopyDFM()) {
354                                                if (other == member || other.getShip() == null || escorted.contains(other)) continue;
355                                                
356                                                float extraDistScore = 0f;
357                                                if (other.getShip().isCruiser() && isCombatUnit(other.getShip())) {
358                                                        extraDistScore = 0f;
359                                                } else if (other.getShip().isDestroyer() && isCombatUnit(other.getShip())) {
360                                                        extraDistScore = 100000f;
361                                                } else if (other.getShip().isFrigate() && isCombatUnit(other.getShip())) {
362                                                        if (enemiesNear) {
363                                                                extraDistScore = 500000f;
364                                                        } else {
365                                                                extraDistScore = 1000000f;
366                                                        }
367                                                } else if (isHive(other.getShip())) {
368                                                        if (enemiesNear) {
369                                                                extraDistScore = 100000f;
370                                                        } else {
371                                                                extraDistScore = 10000000f;
372                                                        }
373                                                } else {
374                                                        continue;
375                                                }
376                                                float dist = Misc.getDistance(member.getLocation(), other.getLocation()) + extraDistScore;
377                                                if (dist < minDist) {
378                                                        closest = other;
379                                                        minDist = dist;
380                                                }
381                                        }
382                                        if (closest != null) {
383                                                member.getShip().getAIFlags().setFlag(AIFlags.TIMID_ESCORT, 2f);
384                                                member.getShip().getAIFlags().setFlag(AIFlags.ESCORT_RANGE_MODIFIER, 2f, 300f);
385                                                escort(member, closest);
386                                        }
387                                }
388                        }
389                        
390                        
391                        if (everHadFabricatorDeployed && fabricators <= 0) {
392                                for (DeployedFleetMemberAPI member : fleetManager.getDeployedCopyDFM()) {
393                                        ShipAPI ship = member.getShip();
394                                        if (ship == null || ship.getAI() == null) continue;
395                                        if (isCombatUnit(ship) || hives <= 0) {
396                                                if (ship.getAI() instanceof ShipAIPlugin) {
397                                                        ship.getAIFlags().setFlag(AIFlags.DO_NOT_BACK_OFF, 2f);
398                                                        ship.getAIFlags().setFlag(AIFlags.DO_NOT_VENT, 2f);
399                                                        ship.getAIFlags().setFlag(AIFlags.IGNORES_ORDERS, 2f);
400                                                }
401                                        }
402                                }
403                        }
404
405                        cleanUpEmptyAssignments();
406                }
407        }
408        
409        protected boolean wantsToControl(Vector2f fabricatorLoc, float axisAngle, float distToEnemyCom, Vector2f objectiveLoc) {
410                float dist = Misc.getDistance(fabricatorLoc, objectiveLoc);
411                float angle = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(fabricatorLoc, objectiveLoc);
412                float angleDiff = Misc.getAngleDiff(axisAngle, angle);
413                
414                float enemyWeight = Misc.countEnemyWeightInArcAroundLocation(owner, objectiveLoc, 0f, 360f, 3000f, null, true, true);
415                if (enemyWeight <= 0f && angleDiff > 30f) return true;
416                //return !(dist > 2000 && (dist > distToEnemyCom || angleDiff > 45f));
417                return dist < 5000 || (dist < distToEnemyCom && angleDiff < 45f);
418        }
419        
420        
421        protected void cancelOrders(DeployedFleetMemberAPI member, boolean withSearchAndDestroy) {
422                AssignmentInfo curr = taskManager.getAssignmentFor(member.getShip());
423                if (curr != null) {
424                        taskManager.removeAssignment(curr);
425                }
426                if (withSearchAndDestroy) {
427                        taskManager.orderSearchAndDestroy(member, false);
428                }
429        }
430        
431        protected void escort(DeployedFleetMemberAPI member, DeployedFleetMemberAPI target) {
432                if (member.getShip() == null) return;
433                AssignmentInfo curr = taskManager.getAssignmentFor(member.getShip());
434                if (curr != null && curr.getType() == CombatAssignmentType.LIGHT_ESCORT && 
435                                taskManager.getAssignmentTargetFor(member.getShip()) == target) {
436                        return;
437                }
438                
439                AssignmentInfo info = taskManager.createAssignment(CombatAssignmentType.LIGHT_ESCORT, target, false);
440                taskManager.setAssignmentWeight(info, 0f);
441                taskManager.giveAssignment(member, info, false);
442        }
443        
444        protected void giveMovementOrder(DeployedFleetMemberAPI member, Vector2f loc, float minDist, float maxDist) {
445                AssignmentInfo curr = taskManager.getAssignmentFor(member.getShip());
446                boolean needToMakeAssignment = curr == null || curr.getTarget() == null || Misc.getDistance(curr.getTarget().getLocation(), loc) > 100f;
447                
448                float dist = Misc.getDistance(member.getLocation(), loc);
449                if (dist < minDist) {
450                        if (curr != null && (curr.getType() == CombatAssignmentType.RALLY_CIVILIAN)) {
451                                taskManager.removeAssignment(curr);
452                        }
453                }
454                
455                boolean needToLeash = false;
456                needToLeash |= curr == null && dist > minDist;
457                needToLeash |= curr != null && dist > maxDist;
458                
459                if (needToMakeAssignment && needToLeash) {
460                        AssignmentTargetAPI wp = taskManager.createWaypoint2(loc, allyMode);
461                        AssignmentInfo task = taskManager.createAssignment(CombatAssignmentType.RALLY_CIVILIAN, wp, false);
462                        taskManager.giveAssignment(member, task, false);
463                }
464        }
465        
466        public void cleanUpEmptyAssignments() {
467                taskManager.reassign(); // so assigned members isn't empty
468                List<AssignmentInfo> remove = new ArrayList<>();
469                for (AssignmentInfo curr : taskManager.getAllAssignments()) {
470                        if (curr.getType() == CombatAssignmentType.CONTROL) continue;
471                        if (curr.getType() == CombatAssignmentType.CAPTURE) continue;
472                        if (curr.getType() == CombatAssignmentType.DEFEND) continue;
473                        if (curr.getAssignedMembers().isEmpty()) {
474                                remove.add(curr);
475                        }
476                }
477                for (AssignmentInfo curr : remove) {
478                        taskManager.removeAssignment(curr);
479                }
480                
481                taskManager.clearEmptyWaypoints();
482        }
483        
484        protected Vector2f getEnemyCenterOfMass() {
485                Vector2f com = new Vector2f();
486                float weight = 0;
487                for (DeployedFleetMemberAPI member : enemyFleetManager.getDeployedCopyDFM()) {
488                        if (member.isFighterWing()) continue;
489                        if (member.getShip() == null) continue;
490                        if (!engine.isAwareOf(owner, member.getShip())) continue;
491                        
492                        Vector2f.add(member.getLocation(), com, com);
493                        weight++; // maybe feels better than scaling weight by ship size etc
494                }
495                if (weight > 0) {
496                        com.scale(1f / weight);
497                }
498                return com;
499        }
500        
501        
502        public static boolean isCombatUnit(ShipAPI ship) {
503                return ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.THREAT_COMBAT);
504        }
505        public static boolean isOverseer(ShipAPI ship) {
506                return ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.THREAT_OVERSEER);
507        }
508        public static boolean isHive(ShipAPI ship) {
509                return ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.THREAT_HIVE);
510        }
511        public static boolean isFabricator(ShipAPI ship) {
512                return ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.THREAT_FABRICATOR);
513                //return ship.getSystem() != null && ship.getSystem().getId().equals(ShipSystems.CONSTRUCTION_SWARM);
514        }
515}
